questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: The experimental value of d is found to be smaller than the estimate obtained using Graham's law. This is due to

options.content: larger mean free path for X as compared to that of Y.
larger mean free path for Y as compared to that of X.
increased collision frequency of Y with the inert gas as compared to that of X with the inert gas.
increased collision frequency of X with the inert gas as compared to that of Y with the inert gas.

questions.explanation: Collision frequency of X is greater than Y.
